'''Shipmaster''', often shortened to '''Master''', was a title used during the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It designated the highest-ranking non-commissioned officer aboard a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] vessel.<ref name="Q&A">{{Faraway|subdomain=blog|url=2011/03/knight-errant-novel-answers-part-i-and.html|text=''Knight Errant'' Q&A|nolive=1}}</ref>
